name: few people realize that _
what_it_is: "Almost nobody knows that _": a dramatic reveal of an overlooked fact about a news event. Usually used in documentary-style storytelling to open a shocking true story. The blank holds the surprising fact, e.g. "Adam Robinson's family had three chances to survive this Florida plane crash, yet they missed every single one."
